name: Effective Caffeine Dose
title: Increase caffeine to your effective dose.
subtitle: Caffeine Dose
rationale: A dose you already tolerate can be timed to support a work window without costing sleep later.

evidence.summary: Caffeine can acutely improve alertness and performance, with response depending on dose and timing.

indications: Morning output lags despite adequate sleep.
Recorded higher-dose days show better focus without a sleep cost.
